product_metadata.title: Veckle Dish Drying Rack, 2 Tier Dish Rack with Removable Drain Board Dish Drainer Utensil Holder, Cutting Board Holder for Kitchen Countertop, Silver
features: Practical and Fashion: 2 Tier dish drying rack and chrome finish combines stylish with functionality, saves space and accommodates more

Large Capacity for Space-saving: 2 Tier drying rack for dishes and accommodates more on kitchen countertop. The dish rack is recommended for families with 2-3 people, maybe too small for a family of four
Non-Slip for More Stable: Shock absorption dish drainer and wear resistance, easy to install
Removable Drain Board: Collect the water and keep the kitchen countertop dry and clean
Sizes: 16.5 inch x 9.8 inch x 13 inch; Please follow the installation manual to assemble this kitchen dish rack
